svg.title: Every configuration beside 24 agent sessions
svg.desc: Each of 18 configurations beside 24 agent sessions of the traces with the largest contexts, a row under its family, in panel a its voice-to-voice p95 on a log scale against the SLO of 2.02 s, the median of its runs and their range, and in panel b the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, only the engine change and the router that aborts agent requests coming near the SLO: tuned vLLM, 512-token steps, 10.14 s at 3,552 tokens/s; 1,024-token steps, no long-prefill threshold, 8.79 s at 3,888 tokens/s; a KV watermark, 10%, 10.65 s at 3,649 tokens/s; a queued-token limit, 8,192 tokens, at least 30 s, 48 turns failed at 5,584 tokens/s; a token reservation, 2,048 tokens, 5.67 s at 3,551 tokens/s; a static cap, 2 agent requests in flight, 8.57 s at 3,446 tokens/s; a static cap, 8 agent requests in flight, 9.88 s at 3,586 tokens/s; vLLM with #54530, at most 12 sequences, 10.93 s at 3,624 tokens/s; SGLang 0.5.22, priority with preemption, 12.05 s at 3,577 tokens/s; SGLang with HiCache, 4x, write-through, 11.95 s at 4,330 tokens/s; llm-d's flow control, emulated, 10.99 s at 3,684 tokens/s; SMG 1.13.0, as shipped, 11.05 s at 3,446 tokens/s; the abort-and-resubmit router, before the first byte, 2.59 s at 3,593 tokens/s; over make-room, its KV reserve on, 2.06 s at 3,355 tokens/s; on tuned vLLM, the gateway's policy alone, 10.99 s at 3,633 tokens/s; make-room alone, #63350, 5.77 s at 3,572 tokens/s; both rules, 16-token window, 3.23 s at 3,540 tokens/s; both rules, 48-token window, 2.19 s at 3,362 tokens/s.
